buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of District Social Defense Officer Mahesana payable at Account payee demand draft/cheque . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of District Social Defense Officer Mahesana payable at Security-Deposite . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) File Attachment Click here to view the file. 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Terms & Conditions for Selection of Manpower Outsourcing Agency Services 1. Turnover & Experience: The agency must have an average annual turnover of Rs. 72.00 (Seventy two) Lakhs or more during the last three years. The agency must also have at least three years of experience in this work. 2. Online Bid Documents: The agency submitting the online bid must properly scan the following do cuments with the authorized person's signature and stamp, create a PDF file sequentially, and uploa d them online on the GeM Portal: 1. Certified copy of the agency/firm's PAN card. 2. Certified copy of the agency/firm's GST registration certificate. 3. Certified copy of the Chartered Accountant's certificate regarding the turnover of the bidder p articipating in the bid for the last 3 (three) financial years (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). The t urnover for any one of the last three financial years (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) must be at l east as per the estimated new Gujarat Purchase Policy and GeM rules. Also, the turnover for t he specific type of work for which the tender has been floated must be shown (As per Annexu re-2). 4. Certified copy of the Professional Tax payment receipt for the year 2025-26.

5. Certified copy of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF) registration certificate. 6. Certified copy of the Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) registration certificate. 7. Certified copy of the Security and Manpower registration certificate of the agency/firm (NSIC Certificate). 8. An undertaking on the bidder's letterhead regarding anti-blacklisting, stating that the agency has not been blacklisted by any government office/department, declared a defaulter by any fi nancial institution, or have any police/court records/cases against them (As per Annexure-4). 9. Proof of experience for security work (PDF of the first page of the Section Order or Contract O rder) (As per Annexure-3). 10. Details of any other agencies owned by the partners or owners of the agency. 11. EMD (Earnest Money Deposit) must be paid mandatorily. Tenders will not be accepted withou t it. 3. Statutory Deductions & Compliance: The finalized agency shall deduct EPF, ESIC, Professional T ax, GST, and any other statutory deductions as per rules from the monthly salary, and deposit the s ame with the respective offices. A statement showing the exact net salary paid to the employee afte r all these deductions must be submitted monthly along with the bill. Name-wise proofs of depositin g all deducted amounts into the respective offices must be submitted with the bill. If the agency fails to deposit the deducted amounts into the respective offices, the sole responsibility for the same shall rest with the agency. 4. Advance Salary: The manpower provided by the agency must be paid one month's salary in advan ce by the agency. 5. Minimum Wages & Direct Transfer: It must be ensured that the exact net remuneration due to t he servant/guard is deposited regularly every month into their respective bank accounts. If this amo unt is paid below the Government's Minimum Wages Act and any issue arises, the sole responsibility shall lie with the agency. 6. Local Presence: The bidder/institution must be local, meaning the office of the bidder/institution must be registered within Gujarat, for which any registration certificate or document issued by the G overnment of Gujarat must be submitted. Rent agreements or partnership deeds will not be accepte d. 7. Valid Registrations: Valid registration for GST, EPF, and ESIC as well as registration for this specifi c operation must be held. 8. No-Blacklist Declaration: The bidder/institution must not be blacklisted or disqualified for providi ng manpower. The agency must provide a certificate on its letterhead with a date post-dating the issuance of the bid, along with signature and stamp, which must be uploaded in the online tender d ocuments. 9. Monthly Bills: The agency must submit GeM-generated and offline bills in two copies every month, along with statements and proofs of deductions such as EPF, ESIC, Prof. Tax, GST, etc. 10. Security Deposit / Affidavit: The finalized agency must submit an affidavit regarding the terms a nd conditions on a Rs. 300.00 stamp paper. 11. Personnel Qualifications & Details: Qualified and experienced personnel/candidates matching th e rules must be allocated for the assigned locations. They must comply with all written or verbal rule s and instructions of the institution. Also, details such as name, age, experience, address, contact n umber, photo, etc., of all guards to be deployed must be uploaded at the time of filing the tender. 12. Liability for Damages: The agency shall be fully responsible for any direct or indirect loss caused to the office property, equipment, official records, or belongings of officers/employees due to ineffici ency, negligence, intentional acts, or any other reason by the outsourced staff provided by the age ncy, and damages will be recovered from the agency. Furthermore, in the event of children escapin g from the institution, if there is negligence on the part of the staff, action will be taken against the m and the agency as per government rules. 13. Termination & Legal Action: The services of any employee/guard/servant appointed by the agen cy can be terminated at any time without giving any notice. Also, civil or criminal action will be take n by the institution, head office, district office, or affiliated office for any embezzlement, malpractic e, irregularity, or fraud during the contract period. 14. No Employment Relationship: The institution shall bear no service-related or future liability what soever for any employee/servant/guard appointed by the agency. 15. Prohibition of Intoxicants: The manpower provided by the agency shall not consume pan, masala , beedi, cigarette, or any other intoxicants during duty. If found doing so, a fine of Rs. 200/- for the fi rst time and Rs. 500/- thereafter will be levied under The Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Pr ohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribut ion) Act, 2003 (COTPA). If the guard fails to pay, it will be deducted from their salary. 16. Prohibition on Providing Prohibited Items to Children: The manpower/guards provided by the agency shall not give pan, masala, beedi, cigarette, or any other intoxicants or restricted articles to children. If restricted articles are found with children, legal action will be taken against the agency a nd the guard. If caught giving or while giving restricted items to children, legal action will be taken

under Section-77 of the Juvenile Justice Act, 2015 and COTPA 2003. 17. Leave & Replacement: If the manpower/guard provided by the agency goes on leave, prior writte n notice must be given, and alternative manpower/guard must be provided in their place; otherwise , salary will be deducted. 18. No Government Benefits: Manpower shall not be entitled to any government or other benefits su ch as allowances or insurance. Leave benefits will be granted according to the rules and circulars of the government from time to time. 19. Termination Without Reason: Notwithstanding any provision in the contract, the competent auth ority/office may terminate the contract by giving a one-month notice or a notice of such duration as specified by the institution or head office, without assigning any reason. No compensation will be gi ven for the remaining period of a contract cancelled in this manner. 20. Compliance with Labor Laws: The agency must strictly comply with the minimum wage acts, res olutions, circulars, and notifications issued by the government from time to time for providing outso urced manpower/guards, and any new rules announced by the government in the future shall also b e binding. 21. Dispute Resolution: In case of any dispute regarding this, the decision of the Superintendent / Dis trict Social Security Officer / Director, Social Security, Gujarat State, Gandhinagar shall be final. 22. Contract Duration: The rates approved for manpower outsourcing services will initially be approve d for 11 months. Thereafter, the agency's services may be continued for up to 6 months or until a n ew tender is approved, based on mutual consent. 23. Submission of Documents: The agency whose tender is approved must submit all necessary doc uments requested by the institution/office, such as GST, PAN card, EPF, ESIC, security license, etc. 24. Modification of Terms: Any amendment, addition, or modification to the aforementioned terms d eemed necessary in the interest of the government/institution shall be binding on the agency. 25. Fluctuation in Staffing: The number of outsourced employees to be provided under this bid may be increased or decreased during the contract period. 26. Payment Procedure: Bills submitted in the subsequent month will be processed as per rules base d on the availability of grants and paid via e-payment through the Treasury Office. 27. No Interest on Delayed Payments: In case of delayed payments due to non-availability of grants , no interest will be paid, and no claim can be made for interest. 28. Jurisdiction: In case of any legal complications/disputes arising in this regard, the jurisdiction shall be Mehsana. 29. Acceptance of GeM General Terms: In addition to the general terms and conditions on the GeM Portal, these additional conditions apply. The agency must upload a document on its letterhead, dat ed after the issuance of the bid, with a signature and stamp stating that these terms and conditions are accepted and binding upon them. 30. Bill Disbursal Condition: The bill amount to be paid to the agency will be disbursed based on the availability of grants and only after submitting the requested documents.
